description: Free. Creates a scannable QR code from a website URL, such as a restaurant menu, event page, business website or product link, with no account or API key required. Encodes the URL as a QR symbol and returns the PNG image, a download link for it on QRCodeDinosaur.com (imageUrl), the SVG markup when format is "svg", and for "direct" codes a pageUrl where the code can be viewed and downloaded for sharing or printing. Direct codes are plain by default and support an optional green dino mascot in the center. Requires a destination URL; supports public HTTP/HTTPS links, not Wi-Fi credentials, contact cards, arbitrary text or decoding an existing QR image. "redirect" codes encode a scan link (scanUrl) that counts scans, and their destination can be changed later by an owner with Pro. Signed in or with an API key, the code belongs to that account. Otherwise the result includes a claimUrl, valid for 30 days, that adds the code to the QR codes of whoever opens it on QRCodeDinosaur.com. Unsafe links and links to private or internal hosts are refused with an error that names the reason.

format.description: "png" (default) returns a hosted PNG. "svg" also returns the SVG markup.

style.description: Plain by default. "green-dino" adds the green dinosaur mascot to a direct code.

url.description: Destination website URL to encode, e.g. https://example.com/menu. Required; https:// is added if no scheme is given.

variant.description: "direct" (default) encodes the URL itself. "redirect" encodes a scan link that counts scans and whose destination can be changed later.

name: create_qr_code
title: Create a QR code
